# Fixture: spotread 校准失败
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS spotread 校准失败输出
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: spotread -e -d l -c 1，然后发送 'c' 校准

# ========== 启动阶段 ==========
ArgyllCMS spotread - Emissive (Display) measurement utility
Version 2.2.1

Setting up instrument ...
Found instrument 'hid:111 (i1 Display Pro, ColorMunki Display)'
Serial Number: XXXXXXXX
Place instrument on measurement area ...
Hit any key to continue:

# ========== 用户发送 'c' 校准命令 ==========
# 校准需要将探头放在校准板上（白板）

# ========== 校准失败 ==========
# 可能原因:
# 1. 校准板位置不对
# 2. 校准板脏污
# 3. 光线干扰

Calibration failed - reflectance sample out of range

# 或者:
Calibration failed - white calibration reading out of range

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 错误关键词检测:
# - "Calibration failed" -> 校准失败
# - "out of range" -> 读数超出范围
# - 应触发 SPOTREAD_ERROR_KEYWORDS 匹配

# ========== 用户提示建议 ==========
# ERROR_MESSAGE_MAP['calibration failed'] =
#   '校准失败，请重新校准探头'

# ========== 关键检测点 ==========
# - 这是校准阶段错误
# - 需要用户重新校准
# - 可以继续测量流程（发送新校准命令）
